title: Character sheet
description: The JSON stored in characters.sheet. Three parts, each with one owner: build (what the wizard decides; replaced whole on every edit), rolls (made by the server, never sent in by the player) and play (what changes at the table; the wizard never touches it). Nothing derived is stored: scores, modifiers and hit points are worked out from build and play each time the sheet is read, so they can't go stale. Kept in other columns: name, personal_notes, is_active; the portrait is in character_portraits.

version.description: The sheet format's version. Bumped when the shape changes; a migration upgrades stored sheets (server/db.py).

level.description: Character level. Set at creation from the campaign (milestone level, else 1). Planned: per-class levels when multiclassing arrives.

rolls.description: The server's ability score rolls the scores were assigned from (roll method), or null.

build.description: The character as the wizard made it: the draft's fields, complete and checked against the campaign when saved. Editing the character replaces this whole object.

originRules.description: The origin rules the character was made under: the sandbox player's picks, or the campaign's at the time.

abilityMethod.description: The method the scores were set with (never null here: the campaign's only method is filled in).

hpRolls.description: The hit die rolled at each level after the first (manual method); empty otherwise.

play.description: What changes at the table. Each field is optional, missing meaning its empty state, so adding a field needs no migration. Planned: xp, current and temporary hit points, spent hit dice, death saves, conditions, inventory and coins, spell slots, limited-use features.

scoreAdjustment.description: set: the score becomes value. atLeast: raised to value unless already higher (most magic items). add: plus value (negative lowers it). The current score is kept within 1-30.
